items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Well, from 1969 I started out with Milt Buckner, an organist, a drifting organist and pianist. I did things with him with piano and things like that.

ctx.x: The last few years you've made trips to Europe. Who do you go there with?

Well, from 1969 I started out with Milt Buckner, an organist, a drifting organist and pianist. I did things with him with piano and things like that. We took the dancers over and we did this and we did that.
